body.text: These Community Standards (“Standards”) establish the conduct expected of users of the BeeBark website, application, platform and related services (“Platform”).

The Standards apply to content and activity on the Platform, including professional profiles, portfolios, project submissions, public posts, comments, reviews, messages, business profiles, job listings, applications and other user-generated material.

These Standards form part of the BeeBark User Agreement (“User Agreement”) and must be read together with the BeeBark Privacy Policy (“Privacy Policy”), the Schedule on Business Accounts, Authorised Hirers and Recruitment, and other applicable Platform policies.
These Standards apply to the extent relevant to each user’s activities and do not replace obligations imposed by applicable Indian law.
BeeBark is intended to facilitate professional visibility, portfolio presentation, discovery, networking, collaboration and hiring within the built environment and related professional sectors.

Users must interact honestly, respectfully and professionally. Disagreement, criticism and good-faith professional debate are permitted, provided they do not involve unlawful threats, harassment, deception, privacy violations or other prohibited conduct.
Users must not use the Platform to intimidate, exploit, threaten, harass or unlawfully discriminate against another person.

Users must not impersonate another person or organisation, create misleading identities, misrepresent professional qualifications, or falsely claim employment, registration, certification, project participation or other professional credentials.
Business representatives must have appropriate authority to act on behalf of the business they represent.
Unless BeeBark expressly indicates otherwise, the presence of a profile, business, credential or portfolio on the Platform does not mean that BeeBark has independently verified or endorsed it.
Users must not use another person’s identity, account, credentials or professional history without appropriate authority.
Users must accurately represent their contribution to projects, designs, drawings, photographs, renders, publications and other professional work.
Users must not falsely claim authorship, ownership, employment, collaboration or participation in a project.
Where appropriate, users should identify collaborators, contributors, photographers, designers, consultants, contractors and other relevant rights holders.

Disputes about authorship, attribution or ownership may be reported to BeeBark. BeeBark may request supporting information and may restrict access to disputed content while assessing a complaint. The submission of content alone does not establish ownership or determine the outcome of an ownership dispute.
Users must publish or upload only content they own or are otherwise legally authorised to use, submit, process or publish.
Users must not infringe copyright, trademarks, design rights, confidentiality obligations, contractual rights, privacy rights or other rights belonging to another person.
Users are responsible for obtaining any permissions required to upload or publish client work, employer-owned designs, project documents, photographs, renders, drawings or other third-party material.
Access to or downloading of content from BeeBark does not, by itself, grant permission to reproduce, publish, commercially exploit or redistribute that content.
Users must not remove or misrepresent attribution or rights notices in order to falsely claim another person’s work.
Users must respect the privacy and personal information of other users and third parties.
Users must not collect, publish, disclose, share, use or otherwise process another person’s personal data unless they have the necessary lawful basis, authority or permission under applicable law.

Users must not publish or disclose another person’s private contact details, account credentials, authentication information, financial information, identity documents, private correspondence or other non-public personal information without appropriate authority.
Users must not use the Platform to stalk, dox, intimidate, blackmail, unlawfully monitor or target another person using their personal information.
Users must not upload confidential client, employer, colleague, collaborator or third-party information unless they are authorised to disclose it and permit the relevant processing.

Users must exercise particular care when uploading project material that identifies private individuals, residential locations, access arrangements, security systems or other information whose disclosure could create a privacy or safety risk.
Users must not use public professional information to conduct unauthorised profiling, harassment, fraud or unrelated commercial solicitation.

The collection, use, sharing, retention and deletion of personal data by BeeBark are governed by the Privacy Policy and applicable law. These Standards do not independently authorise personal-data processing that would otherwise be unlawful.
Depending on the Platform’s design and applicable visibility settings, profiles, portfolios, posts, comments, reviews and other information may be visible to other users or accessible to the public.
Users are responsible for reviewing available visibility and communication controls before publishing information.

Information intentionally made public may be viewed, copied, shared, indexed or redistributed by others. BeeBark may use technical measures to discourage scraping, automated harvesting or bulk extraction, but cannot guarantee that publicly available information will never be copied or redistributed.
Users must not bypass visibility settings, access restrictions or other technical controls to obtain information that they are not authorised to access.
Removing content from the Platform may not remove copies previously made by other users, search engines, third-party services or recipients.
Users must not engage in harassment, bullying, stalking, intimidation, threats, blackmail, targeted abuse or other unlawful conduct.

Prohibited conduct includes repeated unwanted contact, threatening messages, coordinated harassment, malicious exposure of private information and attempts to intimidate a person into withdrawing a complaint or professional opinion.
Users must not use comments, reviews, direct messages or other Platform features to threaten physical harm, incite unlawful violence or facilitate abuse.
Good-faith complaints, factual criticism and legitimate professional disputes are not prohibited merely because they are critical or unwelcome.
Users must not use the Platform to promote unlawful discrimination, targeted abuse or threats against individuals or groups on grounds protected by applicable law.
Users must not publish content that unlawfully incites violence or facilitates targeted harassment or exclusion.
Legitimate discussion, professional analysis, research and good-faith commentary on social or legal issues remain permitted, subject to applicable law and these Standards.
BeeBark is intended for eligible users aged 18 or older, in accordance with the User Agreement.
Users must not use the Platform to exploit, groom, abuse or endanger children or to solicit, create, distribute or facilitate child sexual abuse material or other unlawful exploitative content.
Users must not use the Platform to facilitate trafficking, coercion, exploitation or other abuse of vulnerable persons.
BeeBark may restrict content, suspend accounts or take other appropriate action where necessary to protect users, address suspected unlawful conduct or comply with applicable law.

The processing of children’s personal data, including any corrective action required where such data has been processed contrary to applicable law, shall be governed by the Privacy Policy and applicable law.
Users must not publish or distribute unlawful intimate material, non-consensual sexual imagery, sexual exploitation material or other prohibited sexual content.

Users must not create, upload or distribute manipulated, synthetic or AI-generated imagery or other material that unlawfully impersonates, sexually exploits, defames or violates the privacy or rights of another person.
Users must not use AI tools to create misleading professional credentials, fabricated project evidence or deceptive representations of another person’s work or identity.
Content may be restricted or removed where reasonably necessary to address violations of these Standards, applicable law or the User Agreement.
Users must not use BeeBark to commit or facilitate fraud, phishing, identity theft, financial scams, impersonation or other deceptive or unlawful conduct.
Users must not misrepresent the purpose of a communication, falsely claim affiliation with a business or professional body, or solicit money or information through deceptive means.
Users must not manipulate engagement, ratings, reviews, professional credentials or project claims through fraudulent accounts or coordinated deceptive activity.
Suspected scams may be reported through BeeBark’s available reporting or grievance mechanisms.
Employers, recruiters and authorised hirers must comply with the Schedule on Business Accounts, Authorised Hirers and Recruitment, the Privacy Policy and applicable law.
Users must not publish fictitious opportunities, impersonate employers, misrepresent job conditions, unlawfully discriminate against applicants or facilitate recruitment scams.
Users must not demand, solicit or collect unlawful or prohibited applicant fees, deposits or payments as a condition of applying for, being considered for or obtaining an opportunity.
Candidate information must not be sold, traded, commercially exploited or used for unrelated purposes. Access to candidate information is limited by the applicable terms, privacy obligations and law.
Employers and recruiters are responsible for their handling of candidate information after receipt, including lawful access, use, disclosure, security, retention and deletion.
Candidates may report suspected recruitment fraud, prohibited applicant fees, impersonation or misuse of their information through the available Platform mechanisms.
Users must not send unsolicited bulk messages, repetitive promotional content, deceptive solicitations or other communications that misuse BeeBark’s messaging or networking features.
Users must not use automated accounts, scripts or similar mechanisms to send spam, harvest contact details or circumvent Platform controls.
Users must respect applicable communication controls and must not continue targeted unwanted contact in a manner that constitutes harassment or violates applicable law.
Service-related communications from BeeBark and promotional communications shall be handled in accordance with the Privacy Policy and applicable law.
Reviews, ratings and public claims must be honest, reasonably supportable and not deliberately misleading.
Users must not post fabricated reviews, impersonate customers or collaborators, manipulate ratings, or publish claims they know to be materially false.
Users must not use reviews to threaten, extort, harass or unlawfully discriminate against another person or business.
Good-faith opinions and factual criticism are permitted, subject to applicable law. BeeBark may assess reported content in accordance with these Standards and the User Agreement.
Users must not publish trade secrets, confidential business information, unpublished client materials, restricted project documents or other proprietary information without the necessary authority.
Users are responsible for checking the permissions and restrictions that apply to professional work before uploading it.
Users must not use BeeBark to disclose confidential information obtained through employment, consultancy, professional engagement or another relationship where disclosure is unauthorised.
Where BeeBark receives a credible complaint concerning unauthorised disclosure, it may restrict access to the relevant content while assessing the complaint.
Users must use BeeBark’s AI-assisted features in accordance with the User Agreement, Privacy Policy and applicable feature-specific instructions.
Users must have the necessary rights and authority to submit information for AI processing, including information relating to clients, employers, colleagues, collaborators and other individuals.
Users must not submit confidential or personal information to an AI feature where they lack the authority or lawful basis to permit the relevant processing.
Users are responsible for reviewing and approving AI-generated content before publication and for ensuring that published material is not misleading, unlawful or infringing.
AI-generated output must not be presented in a manner that deliberately misrepresents qualifications, project contributions, authorship or professional experience.

AI processing, including any transfer to third-party AI providers and the handling of prompts, inputs and outputs, is described in the Privacy Policy. These Standards do not make additional promises about the accuracy, uniqueness or retention of AI output.
Users must not attempt unauthorised access to BeeBark systems, accounts, data, infrastructure or restricted functionality.
Users must not introduce malware, conduct unauthorised security probing, circumvent access controls, interfere with Platform operation or exploit vulnerabilities without appropriate authorisation.
Users must not scrape, crawl, bulk-download or automatically harvest Platform content in breach of the User Agreement, applicable restrictions or law.
Users must not use bots, fake accounts, fraudulent engagement or other unauthorised mechanisms to manipulate rankings, discovery, reviews, hiring outcomes or Platform functionality.
Users must not reverse engineer, copy or exploit proprietary Platform systems except to the extent expressly permitted by applicable law or authorised by BeeBark.
Users must not use BeeBark to facilitate unlawful activity, infringe another person’s rights, evade legal obligations or otherwise violate the User Agreement.
Users must not use the Platform to facilitate unauthorised commercial exploitation of other users’ content or information.
Nothing in these Standards prohibits conduct that applicable law expressly protects or permits. Any restriction shall be interpreted and applied consistently with applicable law.
Users may report content or conduct that they reasonably believe violates these Standards through the reporting or grievance mechanisms made available by BeeBark.
Reports should provide sufficient information to identify the relevant content or conduct and enable BeeBark to assess the concern.
Where appropriate, BeeBark may request further information, supporting material or clarification before taking action.
Users must not knowingly submit false or malicious reports intended to harass another user, suppress legitimate criticism or manipulate Platform enforcement.

Privacy-related requests and complaints shall also be handled through the mechanisms identified in the Privacy Policy. Intellectual-property complaints and legally required notices shall be handled under the applicable procedures.

BeeBark may review reported content or activity and take action where it reasonably considers action necessary under the User Agreement, these Standards, applicable law or a lawful order or direction.
Depending on the nature and seriousness of the issue, action may include:

items: removing content or disabling access to it;
restricting messaging, hiring or other Platform functionality;
suspending or terminating an account; or
referring a matter to an appropriate authority where required or appropriate.

body.text: BeeBark may take immediate action where reasonably necessary to address serious security risks, suspected fraud, unlawful conduct, threats to users, misuse of personal data or legal and regulatory exposure.

Where practicable and appropriate, BeeBark may provide notice and an opportunity to respond or remedy a violation. This is subject to the nature of the violation, urgency, security considerations, applicable law and any lawful order or direction.

BeeBark may use automated tools to assist in identifying or reviewing potentially problematic content or activity. Such assistance does not create a guarantee that all violations will be detected or that all moderation decisions will be free from error.
Where BeeBark makes an account, content or access decision, users may seek reconsideration through the appeal or grievance mechanism made available by BeeBark, subject to applicable procedures.
An appeal should identify the relevant decision and explain why the user believes it was incorrect, with supporting information where available.
BeeBark may review the information provided and maintain, modify or reverse the relevant action as appropriate.

Appeals and grievance handling shall be conducted in accordance with applicable law and any applicable statutory timelines. These Standards do not replace legally prescribed grievance procedures or appeal rights.

blocks.title: Content Removal, Account Closure and Data Retention

body.text: BeeBark may restrict or remove content, suspend access or close accounts in accordance with the User Agreement, these Standards and applicable law.
Removing content from public view or closing an account does not necessarily result in immediate deletion of every associated record or copy.
BeeBark’s handling of deletion requests, backups, retained records and personal data after account closure is governed by the Privacy Policy and applicable law.

Information may be retained where reasonably necessary or legally required for purposes such as legal compliance, security, fraud prevention, dispute resolution, enforcement of contractual rights or the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.
BeeBark may be unable to remove copies already made by other users or third-party services. Such limitations do not authorise any person to continue using information unlawfully.
BeeBark may preserve or disclose information where required or authorised by applicable law, a lawful governmental or judicial request, or other lawful process.

BeeBark may also preserve relevant information where reasonably necessary to investigate suspected fraud, security incidents, serious violations, disputes or potential legal claims, subject to applicable law and the Privacy Policy.
Any disclosure to governmental, judicial or law-enforcement authorities shall be handled in accordance with applicable law.
BeeBark provides a professional digital platform for profiles, portfolios, discovery, networking, communication and hiring-related functionality.
Unless expressly stated otherwise, BeeBark does not independently verify every user identity, professional claim, project attribution, review, business representation or recruitment opportunity.
BeeBark does not guarantee that all inappropriate content or misconduct will be identified or prevented. Users remain responsible for exercising appropriate care when interacting with others.

Nothing in these Standards makes BeeBark the owner of user-generated content merely because it is uploaded to the Platform. Ownership and the licence granted to BeeBark are governed by the User Agreement and applicable law.
Nothing in these Standards displaces BeeBark’s obligations under applicable law or the privacy commitments expressly set out in the Privacy Policy.
Users are responsible for their own content, conduct, representations and interactions on BeeBark.
Users must ensure that their submissions and activities comply with these Standards, the User Agreement, the Privacy Policy and applicable law.

Users must obtain necessary permissions before submitting third-party content or personal data and must not assume that information accessible on the Platform is free from intellectual-property, confidentiality or privacy restrictions.
These Standards form part of the User Agreement and must be read with the Privacy Policy and the Schedule on Business Accounts, Authorised Hirers and Recruitment.
The Privacy Policy governs the description of BeeBark’s personal-data processing practices, including data sharing, retention, security, deletion and privacy-related grievance mechanisms.
The Business Accounts and Hiring Schedule governs the specific contractual requirements relating to business access, authorised hirers, candidate information and recruitment conduct.

Where an issue is addressed by more than one policy, the documents shall be interpreted consistently wherever reasonably possible. Applicable law shall prevail in the event of any irreconcilable conflict.

Nothing in these Standards independently expands the categories of personal data BeeBark collects, the purposes for which it processes personal data, or the retention periods described in the Privacy Policy.
BeeBark may update these Standards to reflect changes in law, Platform functionality, security requirements or community expectations.
Material changes shall be communicated through appropriate means where required by the User Agreement or applicable law.
The “Last Updated” date shall identify the latest revision.
Users may report suspected violations through the reporting and grievance mechanisms identified in the User Agreement and on the Platform.
Privacy-related requests and complaints should be submitted through the privacy and grievance contacts specified in the Privacy Policy.
These Standards shall be interpreted in accordance with applicable Indian law and the governing-law provisions of the User Agreement.
By accessing or using BeeBark, users agree to comply with these Standards as incorporated into the User Agreement, to the extent applicable to their use of the Platform.
